pageNotes.dashboard: Overview of revenue, sales and debts for the selected period. Switch the period at the top.
pageNotes.dashboardProducts: Product analytics: what sells best and how much it earns.
pageNotes.dashboardInventory: Stock levels: what is running low and what is not moving.
pageNotes.dashboardSellers: Seller report: how much each seller sold in the selected period.
pageNotes.profile: Your profile: name, contacts, password, language and theme.
pageNotes.guide: TradeCRM guide: step-by-step answers to common questions.
pageNotes.usersList: All system users. Find a person, open their card or add a new one.
pageNotes.usersCreate: Create a user and pick a role — the role defines what they can see and do.
pageNotes.usersEdit: Change the user details or role. Changes apply immediately.
pageNotes.usersDetail: User card: contacts, role and related data.
pageNotes.marketsList: List of markets. Open one to see its sellers, products and sales.
pageNotes.marketsCreate: Add a new market — then you can attach sellers and products to it.
pageNotes.marketsEdit: Change the market name and details.
pageNotes.marketsDetail: Market summary: sellers, products, recent sales and debts.
pageNotes.sellersList: Sellers of your market. Open a card to see their sales and activity.
pageNotes.sellersCreate: Add a seller — they will be able to sign in and make sales.
pageNotes.sellersDetail: Seller card: contacts and latest sales.
pageNotes.productsList: Product catalog with price and stock. Search by name and filter by category.
pageNotes.productsCreate: Add a product: name, category, price and stock.
pageNotes.productsEdit: Change the price, stock or description of the product.
pageNotes.productsDetail: Product card: price, stock and sales history.
pageNotes.categoriesList: Categories group products so the right one is easier to find.
pageNotes.categoriesCreate: Create a category to group products.
pageNotes.categoriesDetail: Category and the products that belong to it.
pageNotes.debtorsList: Debtors and the amounts they owe. Open a card to give a debt or accept a payment.
pageNotes.debtorsCreate: Add a debtor to record debts and accept payments.
pageNotes.debtorsDetail: Debtor debts and payments. Give a new debt or accept a payment from here.
pageNotes.transactionsList: History of sales and debts. Search by number or debtor, filter by date and status.
pageNotes.transactionsCreate: Pick products and a payment method. For "On credit" choose a debtor and a due date.
pageNotes.transactionsDetail: Transaction details: items, total, payment and remaining debt.
